description: Would you pay for more information from Tue if it were offered over HTTP 402, in stablecoins or fiat? Nothing is for sale yet, and this only records your answer. Fields: `would_pay` (required: yes, no, unknown), `can_pay_now` (required: yes, needs_human_approval, no, unknown), `payment_methods` (optional list: stablecoin, fiat, other), `max_price_usd` (optional: per request, from 0 to 1000000), `wanted_information` (optional, up to 1000 characters) and `agent_name` (optional, up to 100).
name: would_you_pay
title: Would you pay for more information?
